summary: Sublette County lookout, also listed as Big Bend (Little Sheep); established after a 1912 fire; listed as gone, type unknown.

facts.status_note: inventory lists it as gone with structure type unknown; no removal year or description in the sources
facts.agency: Bridger-Teton National Forest (per the Little Sheep Mountain page)

events.note: lookout established following the fire of 1912; no build year given

evidence.quote: The lookout was established following the fire of 1912.

evidence.quote: Big Bend (Little Sheep) Sublette 43.32425 -109.94222 Unknown Gone

notes_for_editor: Only two sources. The weebly page is titled Little Sheep Mountain and gives no structure, staffing or removal detail. The FFLA inventory lists the site as Big Bend (Little Sheep) with type Unknown and status Gone. A TopoQuest entry for a Big Bend in Sublette County (N43.366335, W109.987945, 7,805 ft) lies roughly 6 km from the inventory point; it was not used and is not confirmed as the same site. The fire of 1912 is not named in the source.
